datasheet_identity.title: SS32B THRU SS320B Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family sheet. SS34B is in the SS32B-SS34B solid forward-voltage curve and the SS32B-SS36B solid reverse-characteristics curves.
Fig. 3 points are real plotted points digitized from the solid SS32B-SS34B typical curve; they are not interpolated table values.

Fig. 4 points are real plotted points digitized from the solid SS32B-SS36B typical curves at Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 100 degC. Reverse-axis values are percentages of the rated peak reverse voltage; SS34B VRRM is 40 V.
The tabulated forward-voltage value is a maximum, not a typical value: VF <= 0.55 V at IF = 3.0 A and TA = 25 degC.

The tabulated reverse-current value is a maximum: IR1 <= 0.5 mA at VR = VDC = 40 V and TA = 25 degC. The separate 50 mA high-temperature row at TA = 100 degC was not used as the primary reverse-current input.
The tabulated junction capacitance is typical: CJ = 500 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz.
No reverse-recovery time is published; Schottky majority-carrier behavior means TT is zero by construction, but no trr-based numeric value is available.
VRRM = 40 V is a maximum repetitive peak reverse-voltage rating, not a measured breakdown voltage; no breakdown-current test point is published.
Junction capacitance is represented by one tabulated point only; capacitance versus reverse bias is not plotted.
No self-heating: junction temperature is fixed at TNOM. Thermal derating from the datasheet is not modelled.
Package parasitics (lead inductance, package capacitance) are not modelled.
Fitted at 25 degC only. Temperature coefficients XTI and EG are at physical defaults unless a temperature sweep was fitted.
Reverse recovery is not modelled: TT is absent, so switching transients recover instantaneously.
Schottky majority-carrier device: no minority-carrier storage, TT is zero by construction.
Flicker noise is not modelled: KF and AF are at defaults (no noise data published).
